She wears a floor-length grand boubou with an ample rectangular body, broad open sleeves, and dense embroidery framing the neck and center front over a coordinated inner wrapper. Resolve the garment as an expansive near-rectangular boubou body; both broad sleeve openings remain visible; dense embroidery frames the neckline and center front; a coordinated inner wrapper remains visible beneath the outer robe; the continuous shoulder-to-body volume remains legible. She catches a falling paper architecture model against one forearm while the opposite sleeve opens into a full drape. Converging seams aim attention at the opened sleeves. Frame her full body and lower hem, with natural skin texture, textile weight, warm installation light, and cool skylight spill.
